body:
## Summary

Checkpoint the bounded M3-b-2A in-process transport slice on base `dd190b914e9f791c0bb1fd77bf953e6a5bb656ec`.

This PR contains exactly:

- six M3-b-2A implementation/test files: the child codec, materializer transport helpers, inert parent adapter, and their three focused test modules;
- two `report_only` test receipts;
- two exact-path `.gitattributes` rules preserving the receipt bytes.

## Validation

- Focused M3-b-2A suite: `251 passed`.
- Bootstrap-adjacent suite: `292 passed`.
- Canonical local precommit: shared smoke passed and `201 passed`.
- Commit diff check passed.
- The committed JSON and TXT receipt blobs match the primary raw source byte-for-byte:
  - JSON: 1,060 bytes, SHA-256 `a61ae57adeda8473571b67317013edda5122444ab6db7342fa59f41028faa472`.
  - TXT: 426 bytes, SHA-256 `a7bee1a9ebe5142a0deb7d9508f1952a3ff43244aaa663bd465a7ee842af92d4`.

The real-byte validation and exact-commit review were performed independently after the checkpoint was created.

## Boundaries

The receipts do not prove authenticity or semantic correctness; they explicitly remain `report_only` artifacts.

This PR excludes PLAN, root memory, B-1/private-rendering work, historical A/B evidence, and the temporary compatibility config.

It does not start or authorize M3-b-2B, M3-b-3, Gate 1, A/B execution, or attempt-05. It does not establish Gate 3 effectiveness.
title: Gate 3: checkpoint M3-b-2A transport
